controls.name: ordering-global-first
controls.source:
Function Snapshot() As String
Dim n As Name,s As String,ws As Worksheet
For Each n In ActiveWorkbook.Names
s=s & "[" & n.Name & ":" & n.RefersTo & "]"
Next
s=s & ";locals="
For Each ws In ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets
s=s & "{" & ws.Name & ":"
For Each n In ws.Names
s=s & n.Name & "|"
Next
s=s & "}"
Next
Snapshot=s
End Function
Function Probe() As String
Dim a As Worksheet,b As Worksheet,c As Worksheet,s As String
Application.EnableEvents=False
Set a=ActiveSheet:a.Name="Z owner"
Set b=Worksheets.Add(After:=a):b.Name="A owner"
Set c=Worksheets.Add(After:=b):c.Name="O'Brien"
ActiveWorkbook.Names.Add Name:="Same",RefersTo:="=7"
ActiveWorkbook.Names.Add Name:="AA",RefersTo:="=10"
ActiveWorkbook.Names.Add Name:="'Z owner'!ZZ",RefersTo:="=11"
ActiveWorkbook.Names.Add Name:="Zulu",RefersTo:="=1"
ActiveWorkbook.Names.Add Name:="'Z owner'!Alpha",RefersTo:="=2"
ActiveWorkbook.Names.Add Name:="'A owner'!Zulu",RefersTo:="=3"
ActiveWorkbook.Names.Add Name:="Alpha",RefersTo:="=4"
ActiveWorkbook.Names.Add Name:="'O''Brien'!Same",RefersTo:="=5"
ActiveWorkbook.Names.Add Name:="'Z owner'!Same",RefersTo:="=6"
ActiveWorkbook.Names.Add Name:="'A owner'!Same",RefersTo:="=8"
s="before=" & Snapshot()
c.Name="AA renamed"
s=s & ";renamed=" & Snapshot()
b.Move Before:=a
Probe=s & ";moved=" & Snapshot()
End Function

controls.name: RenameBook
controls.source:
Function Snapshot() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet,r As Range,u As Range
Set ws=Worksheets(1)
Set r=ws.Range("A1"):Set u=ws.Range("A1,B2")
Snapshot="owner=" & ws.Name & ";single=" & r.Address(External:=True) & ";union=" & u.Address(External:=True) & ";relative=" & r.Address(False,False,xlR1C1,True,ws.Range("C3"))
End Function
Function Probe() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet,r As Range,s As String
Application.EnableEvents=False
Set ws=ActiveSheet:ws.Name="Data"
Set r=ws.Range("A1")
s="before=" & Snapshot()
ws.Name="Renamed"
Probe=s & ";held=" & r.Address(External:=True) & ";after=" & Snapshot()
End Function
